description: Header file defining a template class for HMAC (Hash-based Message Authentication Code) using various hash algorithms, including methods for setting keys, resetting, and computing the HMAC result.

classes.name: HMACType
classes.description: Template class implementing HMAC with a specified hash algorithm, providing key management, reset, and result retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Sets the HMAC key, hashing it if necessary, and prepares inner and outer pads.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal hash algorithm state and initializes it with the inner pad.

methods.name: Result
methods.description: Returns the computed HMAC value, performing final hashing if not already computed.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Feeds data into the hash algorithm for HMAC computation.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloaded operators to input data into the HMAC object.
